name: A cook doesn't show
prompt: A cook on tonight's schedule hasn't come in and isn't answering their phone. The tickets are already coming.

choices.text: Call around until someone can come in

outcome.told: The third person you call says yes and comes in an hour later. The first hour is slow, but nobody walks out.

choices.text: Work their station as well as running the line

outcome.told: You run the line and the empty station until close. The owner counts the night's tickets and nods.

failure.told: You fall behind on both. Two tables send food back, and one leaves before it comes.
